rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese term for an audio or video tape cassette.

example.jyutping: nei1 hap6 kaa1 sik1 daai3 zung6 bo3 dou2

rows.note: Use this for a cassette-like cartridge or removable unit, especially in technical contexts.

example.english: The cassette in this air conditioner can be removed and washed.
example.traditional: 呢部冷氣機個匣可以拆出嚟洗。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 laang5 hei3 gei1 go3 haap6 ho2 ji5 caak3 ceot1 lei4 sai2
